SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT RECEIPT_NO, RECEIPT_LINE_NO, TRANSACTION_ID, PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID FROM UCUBE.XOIF_PUR_KEP_RECEIPT WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY RECEIPT_NO, RECEIPT_LINE_NO, TRANSACTION_ID, PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID ORDER BY RECEIPT_NO, RECEIPT_LINE_NO, TRANSACTION_ID, PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'HSDE' AS BUYER ,'KA' AS SITE ,TRANSACTION_ID ,PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID ,DECODE(TRANSACTION_TYPE,'DELIVER','C','D') AS STATUS ,TO_CHAR(TRANSACTION_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS GR_DATE ,RECEIPT_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO ,QUANTITY AS GR_QTY ,TO_CHAR(RECEIPT_LINE_NO,'FM00000') AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ ,PO_NUMBER AS LEGACY_PO_NO ,TO_CHAR(PO_LINE_NUM,'FM00000') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ ,ITEM_NUMBER AS BUYER_ITEM_NO ,CURRENCY_CODE ,UNIT_PRICE ,round(QUANTITY * UNIT_PRICE,0) AS GR_AMT ,PR_NO||'-'||PR_LINE_NO AS LEGACY_PR_NO ,IF_FLAG ,IF_DATE ,ATTRIBUTE1 ,ATTRIBUTE2 ,ATTRIBUTE3 ,ATTRIBUTE4 ,ATTRIBUTE5 ,ATTRIBUTE6 ,ATTRIBUTE7 ,ATTRIBUTE8 ,ATTRIBUTE9 ,ATTRIBUTE10 ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE ,LAST_UPDATED_BY ,CREATION_DATE ,CREATED_BY ,LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN FROM UCUBE.XOIF_PUR_KEP_RECEIPT WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND TRANSACTION_ID = $G_RS.TRANSACTION_ID$ AND PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID = $G_RS.PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID$
UPDATE UCUBE.XOIF_PUR_KEP_RECEIPT SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND TRANSACTION_ID = $G_RS.TRANSACTION_ID$ AND PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID = $G_RS.PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID$
